steps.note: Document-start hook for CAS /api/cas/customer/web/qr-code only. Do NOT call edith sns qrcode/create (that is C-end www mobile/login).
B-end unified login (sellercustomer / beer-login). Prefer a clean account jar: POST /session/create {account} then pass session_id.
SMS/account face first; QR mode is behind the top-right mode icon (css-wemwzq = qrCodeIcon).
DOM click on top-right icon. Engine CSS often mis-places the icon (getBoundingClientRect→0,0) so click_xy is unreliable; .click() is the proven path 2026-10-13.
ScanLogin face: title APP扫一扫登录 + page QR . Channels include 千帆.
Gate: must be customer.xiaohongshu.com/loginconfirm + 千帆 channel. Never accept www C-end mobile/login.
Exact page bitmap (data:image/png;base64,…). Prefer this over regenerating from URL when handing to humans; if engine raster is blank, re-encode loginconfirm URL locally from saved.qr.url.
Human crop of page QR. Layout paint may be wrong on full-page shots; qr_data / qr.url are source of truth.

HUMAN: 千帆 App 扫一扫 saved.qr_data / qr_shot / /live?session= then confirm. Page polls CAS (CREATE=2 WAIT_CONFIRM=3 LOGIN_SUCCESS=1 EXPIRED=4). Wait until ark workspace WITHOUT ticket= query and WITHOUT 凭证已过期 modal — ticket still in URL means SSO not finished.
Witness: seller/info/v2 success. Receipt session_id is the merchant jar for xhs-merchant-publish.
